name: org.gamblemath/quant-lab
title: GambleMath — Casino RTP, Bonus EV & UKGC Register Lab
description: Quantitative casino slot RTP database (4,362 games), UKGC register lookup & Monte Carlo EV math.

tools.name: audit_slot_rtp
tools.description: Technical specs of a catalogue slot: the RTP with its source, the RTP settings the studio page gives, the maximum win and the bankroll half-life. The catalogue holds 4,362 slots.

slug.description: Slot slug (e.g. sweet-bonanza, gates-of-olympus, wanted-dead-or-a-wild, book-of-dead)

tools.name: simulate_bonus_ev
tools.description: Calculate closed-form Cash EV ($) and completion probability (%) for a casino deposit bonus.

tools.name: audit_parlay_and_cashout
tools.description: Calculate multi-leg parlay compounded bookmaker hold and Early Cash-Out vs manual hedge equity.

tools.name: lookup_ukgc_domain
tools.description: Look up a casino domain in the UKGC public register, read on 2026-11-19: account number, licence holder and the status of the domain.
